{{Top|leg}}
The '''FT-series''' was a series of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] produced by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]], based on the [[PT-7 starfighter|PT-7 design]]. The series included the [[FT-5A Honor Guard]], [[FT-6 Pike]], [[FT-7B Clarion]], [[FT-8 Star Guard]], and the [[PT-7 starfighter]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
